name: Pectins
aliases: E440, E440(i), E440(ii), INS 440, pectin, pectins, non-amidated pectin, amidated pectin, amidated pectins
what_is: Pectin is what makes jam set. It is in fruit — mostly in lemon and orange peel, and in what is left of the apple after it has been pressed. That is where it is taken from, purified, and added to yoghurts, drinks, sweets and desserts to thicken them. On the label it is E440.
why_botia: In the NutriNet-Santé cohort, which followed 92,000 adults for years, women who had not yet reached menopause and took more E440 had more breast cancer diagnoses than those who took less. In women past menopause it was not observed. The finding is about pectin added as an additive, not about fruit.

title: Pectins
description: Pectin is what makes jam set, taken from citrus peel and apple and added to yoghurts, drinks and desserts as E440. In the NutriNet-Santé cohort, premenopausal women with higher intake had more breast cancer diagnoses.
